rounds.summary: Basel-based Nouscom closed an oversubscribed $135 million Series D financing, co-led by M Ventures and Revelation Partners. rounds.summary: Dream Labs, a robot AI startup founded in April 2026 and headquartered in San Francisco, has raised a $90 million seed round led by B Capital. The company also launched Dream-1, a public API giving developers access to its general-purpose robot foundation model. The funds will go toward AI training compute and expanding supported robot hardware.

rounds.highlight: Its Dream-1 model runs in AI data centers and is offered via a public API, so robots can use the intelligence remotely without the developer hosting large models; the team includes former NVIDIA robot-learning researchers.
rounds.description: Dream Labs is a robot AI company building a general-purpose foundation model that controls different robots from camera video and natural-language instructions.
rounds.use_of_funds: Securing computing resources for AI training and expanding the number of supported robots.

sources.title: UAE start-up Ayan raises Dh2.2mln as AI assistants reshape how consumers choose brands
UAE-Based AI Startup Ayan Raises $600,000 to Help Brands Adapt to AI-Driven Shopping

rounds.summary: Ayan, a UAE-based AI startup, has raised Dh2.2 million (about $599,000) in pre-seed funding from strategic global business angels. The company analyses how AI assistants describe a brand, then briefs the sales advisers who serve shoppers, and says it already works with more than 50 brands across MENA, Europe and North America. The funding is not stated to be for any specific purpose beyond the company's plan to scale globally.
rounds.headline: Ayan raises $599K pre-seed to track how AI assistants pitch brands to shoppers | Dealroom News
rounds.highlight: Ayan links AI brand-visibility monitoring with in-store clienteling, measuring how changes in AI answers affect sales outcomes.
rounds.description: Ayan is an AI startup that monitors how AI assistants describe brands to consumers and briefs sales teams to act on that information.

rounds.summary: POV Beauty, a skin prep brand co-founded by creator Mikayla Nogueira and beauty executive Ani Hadjinian, announced a Series A round led by Silas Capital with participation from RÉDO Capital and existing investor Imaginary Ventures. The funding will support its growth across retail and ecommerce following its nationwide Sephora launch. The money will go toward scaling operations, expanding the team, and developing new products.

rounds.use_of_funds: Accelerating growth within Sephora, expanding the team, growing its presence on TikTok Shop, and developing skincare-makeup hybrid products.

sources.title: Sync startup Maia Universe inks more deals and raises funding

rounds.summary: Maia Universe, a sync-licensing startup, has raised new strategic funding from industry investors including MxM, ABBA's Björn Ulvaeus and RMV, the Stockholm studio founded by Benny Andersson and Ludvig Andersson. The announcement came alongside new deals with BMG, Kobalt Music, Warner Music Group and Cooking Vinyl, and a 2027 pilot with MCPS. The amount raised was not disclosed.
rounds.headline: Sync startup Maia Universe inks more deals and raises funding
rounds.highlight: The company has signed deals with more than 200 labels and 90 publishers, and its platform has a pipeline of around 10k new tracks a week.
rounds.description: Maia Universe is a sync-licensing platform that connects music rights holders with sync opportunities.
